beliefs: The box shifts each character forward by a fixed offset in the ASCII/codepoint ordering: 'a'->'i' (+8), 'A'->'I' (+8), '1'->'9' (+8), ' '->'(' (+8), '!'->')' (+8) [E1]
The shift is +8 for every character, applied independently to each character of the input [E1]
notes: All ten observations are consistent with adding 8 to each character's codepoint: a->i, A->I, 1->9, space->(, !->), ab->ij, 'a b'->'i(j', Hello->Pmttw, 123->9:;, a1!->i9). Implemented as chr(ord(c)+8) per character.
